proof_body:
by
  intro a b c p q ha hpq hp hq
  have h1 : a * (p + q) + b = 0 := mul_left_cancel₀ (sub_ne_zero.2 hpq) (by linear_combination hp - hq : (p - q) * (a * (p + q) + b) = (p - q) * 0)
  constructor
  · rw [eq_div_iff ha]
    linear_combination h1
  · rw [eq_div_iff ha]
    linear_combination p * h1 - hp
target_source: ∀ (a b c p q : ℝ), a ≠ 0 → p ≠ q → a * p ^ 2 + b * p + c = 0 → a * q ^ 2 + b * q + c = 0 → p + q = -b / a ∧ p * q = c / a
